title: Port cylinder fitting kernels and the marked-cylinder element body
scope: cylinder.ts radial/cylinderResidual, axisFromNormals, fitCylinderOnAxis, refineCylinderGeometric, fitCylinderClipped, cylinderFrom2 and ransacCylinder; circle2d.ts fitCircle2d; fitCylinderFromSeed.ts fitCylinderOnSelection with cylinderResult and fitInsideWindow; extents.ts axialExtents; V8's Math.atan2 (fdlibm) for the coverage angles. splitTwoCylinders, seeded fitting/region growing and the engine command/CLI are not in this unit.
acceptance: Original and Rust give bit-identical results (floats, used/inlier order, fitted/refused shape) on an independent corpus covering full and partial arcs, tilted axes, noise, outliers, offset coordinates, tiny and huge radii, planes, too few points, NaN and on-axis points; a wrong Rust value fails the comparison.
open_items: pinned_cylinder_comparison: 170/170 bit-identical against the pinned original (133 fitted, 17 refused with the original's FitError text, 20 refinements), corpus fixtures/cylinder/generate.py, oracle oracle/cylinder.cjs. Wrong values fail it: damping 0.3 -> 0.31 (kernels) and coverage 360 -> 359.999 (marked body).

js_atan2 (port-core numeric, fdlibm as V8): 300,289 pairs bit-identical with Node 22 Math.atan2 (atan2_matches_node). Rust f64::atan2 differs for about 1 in 6 inputs; native_plane_finish.rs and native_project_state.rs switch to it in engine.measurement.cylinder.
Verification label and roster registration wait for the owner-scheduled milestone batch (2026-11-05 verification budget).
